name: TS Network CRM
summary: A multi-role CRM for coordinating internet repeater and security camera visits, customer calls, appointments, payments, inventory, and field work.
functions: Schedules calls and technical visits, assigns field tasks, tracks monthly payments and stock, and generates operational PDFs across four permission levels.
problem: Calls, visits, collections, inventory, and technician assignments were difficult to coordinate across separate workflows and roles.
solution: I centralized operations in one role-based system with an agenda, field visit management, payment tracking, stock control, tasks, and PDF reports.

demo.title: Private system
demo.description: Public access is unavailable because the platform belongs to the company and contains sensitive customer and operational data.
